name: artificer
description: Platform for managing remote AI coding agents on EC2 instances

scripts.link: cd packages/runtime && npm link && cd ../cli && npm link
scripts.unlink: cd packages/cli && npm unlink -g && cd ../runtime && npm unlink -g
scripts.publish-packages: pnpm --filter @artificer-ai/runtime build && pnpm --filter @artificer-ai/runtime build:ui && pnpm --filter @artificer-ai/cli build && changeset publish
scripts.ci: node scripts/check-pinned-deps.mjs && turbo run lint type-check test build
